title: P23 product links on magnet pages - match audit
rules: Exact case match only. A topic match is not a case match.
Free explainer first, then the paid guide or book.
Reuse only product URLs already in the repo. No new URLs.
Missing Persons: a guide only when the case is charged. No sales pitch on a still-missing person's card.
Jury Chess stays on the existing per-entry allowlist. Never inferred from a title or topic.
Status-true words (L1-L4). Skip and flag any product that looks out of date.
